Proof from the house tool (morse.py, pulse mode): "PURPLE RAT" at a 240ms unit and at a 37ms unit decoded identically both times — SAME MEANING. (2) **Rule change for the hunt, his order:** for single-family HOUSES, do not be afraid of single landlords with single listings — the more-than-one-listing rule is relaxed for houses (it still stands for apartments/units). Private individual landlords only and the scam screen still apply. Sweep 3 (houses, Cornell 100-mi ring) launched on this order.

- Nov 24, 2026 (~1:43 PM CST, live voice call, this side chat): **Mrs. Williams has passed away — and a librarian-job thought, both his account.** Douglas reported that Mrs. Williams — the pastor's wife, who was the librarian — has passed away; her daughter Karis (his settled spelling; not Cara his ex-wife) is about his dad's age. He doesn't know what to say to the family and feels bad for her. In the same breath, his thought, filed as his musing and not a decision: the library will need a librarian, and he is the local historian from years ago and a former city alderman — it might be a perfect job for him: sit-down work, a few bucks, and "not impossible for me to get." No steps taken or asked for yet. If it came through, he noted, he could afford more than $20/month in Muse tokens.
